prompts.organize:
Help me organize the following product idea and materials into requirement cards. First ask about missing context. Include the user problem, target users, scenarios, scope, priority, and acceptance criteria. Clearly separate facts from assumptions.

Product idea and materials:
prompts.prd:
Help me write a reviewable PRD from the following requirements. First clarify missing information, then cover goals, user flows, features, interaction rules, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and open questions. Do not invent business data.

Requirements:
prompts.review:
Review the following requirements or PRD for missing rules, permissions, edge cases, failure paths, and acceptance criteria. List each issue with its impact, suggested resolution, and questions to confirm.

Requirements or PRD:
